subject: three rose-colored blocks around a cantilevered stair
art_direction: 几块玫色体量围住一段悬挑台阶，青灰阴影与上方空光形成安静建筑错觉。
visible_description: 几块玫色体量围住一段悬挑台阶，青灰阴影与上方空光形成安静建筑错觉。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Create three rose-colored blocks around a cantilevered stair. The stair connects two blocks clearly, while the third casts a broad cool shadow. Keep all forms rectangular with slightly softened edges, avoiding impossible tangled geometry. The highest block ends below the upper fifth so the pale background remains empty. Use no windows, figures, or text, emphasizing the negative spaces. Use matte architectural concept illustration. Vertical 1024x1536 wallpaper; reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet sky or light, with no text, logo, or watermark.
